method: Web search through CloakBrowser: read Bing search-result HTML with cloak-fetch, parse anchor URLs using Python's HTMLParser and urllib.parse, decode Bing redirect targets, and retain only source-domain links. No image or screenshot was opened.
search_limit: Built-in web search calls returned no usable result payload; Google queries did not produce usable source URLs. Bing source-link discovery succeeded. Search summaries and AI overview text are not scientific evidence.

results.note: The already read web.chemteam.info paper has the same article path and identifies Rutherford's primary 1911 paper. The model-summary and abstract search hits were not consulted.

chronology_note: Initial web searches preceded the primary page reads. Because usable search result links were not returned, source URLs were independently confirmed by successful Bing URL discovery afterward. Existing source-page text snapshots were retained once and were not replaced.
